description: This source file defines two Orleans grains, ConcurrentGrain and ConcurrentReentrantGrain, which include methods for initialization, concurrent operations, tail calls, and reentrant behavior, along with logging integration.

classes.name: ConcurrentGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing IConcurrentGrain that supports initialization, concurrent method calls, and tail call patterns.

classes.name: ConcurrentReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain implementing IConcurrentReentrantGrain with tail call capabilities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the grain, creating child grains if index is zero.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Performs concurrent calls to child grains' B method, logging steps.

methods.name: B
methods.description: Logs invocation and simulates a delay with Thread.Sleep, returning an integer.

methods.name: ModifyReturnList_Test
methods.description: Modifies and returns an internal list asynchronously.

methods.name: TailCall_Caller
methods.description: Initiates a tail call to another grain, optionally using continuation while tail call optimization applies.

methods.name: TailCall_Resolver
methods.description: Calls into another grain while a tail call is pending, testing reentrant behavior.

methods.name: Initialize_2 (In ConcurrentReentrantGrain)
methods.description: Initializes the reentrant grain with an index setting.

methods.name: TailCall_Called
methods.description: Sets up a task completion source for a tail call.

methods.name: TailCall_Resolve
methods.description: Completes the tail call by setting its result.
